purpose: Compact real-field terrain pack metadata: raster placement, tree estimates and source credits; generated by realfield/pack.py.
frame: x = metres east, y = metres north of the Runway 2 pad centre on the exact WGS84 local tangent plane (what Gazebo uses); z = metres NAVD88 minus home altitude. +proj=tmerc +lat_0=36.2147411 +lon_0=-96.006723 +k=1 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs

height.what: bare-earth ground height, metres NAVD88 = offset + value * scale (USGS 3DEP lidar DTM 2017 + edits, 1 m means of the 0.5 m DTM)

colour_near.what: ground colour RGB (NAIP 2023-09-18 graded to Sept 2026, 3D-tree crowns painted out) around the search areas and the pad

class.what: ground class per pixel in the search areas and at the pad

colour_far.what: ground colour RGB of the whole terrain at 1 m (same processing)

canopy.what: closed-forest canopy height above the ground, m (2017 lidar, highest return within 1.5 m, smoothed, + estimated growth to 2026); 0 = no forest

dtm_edits.name: soil_piles_levelled
dtm_edits.why: three soil piles 9.7, 6.4 and 5.4 m tall (about 16,400 m3) south-east of Search Boundary 1 in the 2017 lidar are GONE (levelled pasture) in NAIP 2023, NAIP 2025 and OKMaps 2025. Recipe of the elevation research (v08): grey opening of the DTM with a 41 m window inside this box, which removes bumps narrower than 41 m and keeps the natural slope.

dtm_edits.name: new_wetland
dtm_edits.why: a wetland basin was dug west of Search Boundary 1 after 2017 (bare excavation with an excavator in NAIP 2023, wet ground in March 2025, green in September 2026). Its depth is NOT known: 0.8 m is an estimate (the research suggested 0.5 to 1.5 m). Smooth bowl, deepest in the middle.

dtm_edits.name: pad_levelled
dtm_edits.why: the 12.2 m pad square (+0.5 m, 2.0 m feather) is set to the home height so the flat concrete pad model sits flush (the old strip there slopes by 0.344 m)

computed_in_stage_1.how: median Sentinel-2 reflectance ratio s2_2026-09-15_B4B3B2B8.tif / s2_2023-09-23_B4B3B2B8.tif over grass-like 10 m cells (R, G, B)
